change_summary: Add one fixed incident summary terminal task and exact data checks for the first complete backend lifecycle pilot.

task_examples.title: Summarize incident events in the terminal
task_examples.content:
# Summarize the incident events

Inspect `events.jsonl` in the terminal. Produce `summary.json` with exact per-service total and error counts using the format and rules in the project guide. Submit the two root files as a ZIP. You may use any terminal command or editor; the checker reads the output data and never executes a submitted script.
